sectionsContent.title: Unit 2 Study Guide
sectionsContent.directions: Answer each prompt in a few words or a short sentence. Use your guided notes if you get stuck.

blocks.heading: A  ·  Big Ideas of the Unit
blocks.label: ANSWER IN A SHORT SENTENCE
prompts: List the four units of geologic time, from largest to smallest.
In what kind of rock are most fossils found? Why there?
What made oxygen build up in the air (the Great Oxidation Event)?
When volcanoes add CO₂ and other greenhouse gases to the air, what happens to temperatures?
When ice sheets grow, what happens to sea level?
What kind of event ends both the Paleozoic Era and the Mesozoic Era?
Since the age of the dinosaurs, has Earth's climate warmed or cooled?

blocks.heading: B  ·  The Precambrian
blocks.label: THE FIRST 88%: HADEAN, ARCHEAN, PROTEROZOIC
rows: Eons  Name the three, oldest to youngest:
Time  About how much of Earth's history does it cover?
Hadean  What was happening to the young Earth?
Archean  What formed on the surface? What lived there?
Proterozoic  How did the air change? Why did it matter for life?

blocks.label: SNOWBALL EARTH
rows: BIG FOCUS  What was Snowball Earth, and when did it happen?
The thaw  What ended Snowball Earth?

blocks.label: CAMBRIAN PERIOD
rows: Earth  What covered the edges of the continents?
Life  Where did all life live?
Climate  Warm or cold? Sea level high or low?
BIG FOCUS  What was the Cambrian Explosion?
blocks.heading: C  ·  The Paleozoic Era  (about 539 to 252 million years ago)

blocks.label: ORDOVICIAN PERIOD
rows: Earth  What covered large areas of the continents?
Life  What thrived in the sea? What first reached land?
Climate  How did it change by the end of the period?

blocks.label: SILURIAN PERIOD
rows: Earth  Which two landmasses collided?
Life  What new fish appeared? What grew on land?
Climate  What happened after the Ordovician ice age?

blocks.label: DEVONIAN PERIOD
rows: Earth  Where did reefs thrive?
Life  What spread across the land?
Climate  What were the seas like? How did it end?
BIG FOCUS  Why is it called the "Age of Fishes"?

blocks.label: CARBONIFEROUS PERIOD
rows: Earth  Which supercontinent was forming?
Life  What giant animals lived on land?
Climate  What happened to oxygen and CO₂?
BIG FOCUS  What is the Carboniferous famous for?

blocks.label: PERMIAN PERIOD
rows: Earth  What did the continents form? What surrounded it?
Life  Was Dimetrodon a dinosaur?
Climate  What happened by the end of the period?
BIG FOCUS  What caused the end-Permian extinction?

blocks.label: TRIASSIC PERIOD
rows: Earth  What began to happen to Pangaea?
Life  What had to happen after the Permian die-off?
Climate  What were the inland areas like?
BIG FOCUS  What new animal group appeared?
blocks.heading: D  ·  The Mesozoic Era  (about 252 to 66 million years ago)

blocks.label: JURASSIC PERIOD
rows: Earth  What new ocean opened?
Life  Which dinosaurs ruled the land?
Climate  Greenhouse or icehouse?
BIG FOCUS  Why is Archaeopteryx important?

blocks.label: CRETACEOUS PERIOD
rows: Earth  What flooded the continents?
Life  What new kind of plant spread?
Climate  What were conditions like for most of the period?
BIG FOCUS  What ended the Cretaceous? What died?

blocks.label: PALEOGENE PERIOD
rows: Earth  What landmass crashed into Asia?
Life  Who took over the space the dinosaurs left?
Climate  Which way did temperatures go?
blocks.heading: E  ·  The Cenozoic Era  (about 66 million years ago to today)

blocks.label: NEOGENE PERIOD
rows: Earth  Which mountains kept growing?
Life  What spread across the land? Who ate it?
Climate  Warmer or cooler? Wetter or drier?

blocks.label: QUATERNARY PERIOD
rows: Earth  What advanced and retreated over the land?
Life  Which species evolved?
Climate  What paces the ice-age cycles?
BIG FOCUS  What is the Holocene?
